### ① Derived judgments

- **(a) Group list vs the spec — exact match, nothing missing, nothing extra.** Installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0 read from the published tarball (registry `dist.integrity` equals the objectui `pnpm-lock.yaml` pin at line 4204; its `dist/` is byte-identical to the pnpm virtual-store copy in the sibling worktree `/home/user/objectui-issue-10221/node_modules/.pnpm/@objectstack+spec@17.4.0_ai@7.0.65_zod@4.4.3_/`, which is what the walk imports since `/home/user/objectui` itself has no `node_modules`). A read-only node probe from my scratch directory imported `dist/api/index.mjs` and `dist/system/index.mjs`: `GetTranslationsResponseSchema.shape.translations` is a plain ZodObject whose keys are `objects, apps, messages, globalActions, dashboards, datasets, pages, flows, settings, metadataForms, settingsCommon`; `TranslationDataSchema` has the same eleven in the same order; the shape is strict (`{ bogus: {} }` and `{ validationMessages: {} }` are refused) and each group alone parses. `PlatformTranslationDataSchema` does not exist in 17.4.0. objectstack `origin/main` `fc6ddb87a` (`packages/spec/package.json` still 17.4.0; newer than the `61609ed` the report cites, same answer): `appTranslationDataShape()` at `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts:739` lists ten keys (no `settings`), `platformSettingsShape()` at line 1367 adds `settings`, `PlatformTranslationDataSchema` (line 1489) spreads both, and `GetTranslationsResponseSchema` (`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts:3177`) types `translations` as `PlatformTranslationDataSchema`. The module-private `SPEC_TRANSLATION_GROUPS` in `packages/i18n/src/utils/spec-translations.ts:76-88` is exactly those eleven.
- **(b) No real flat producer can be misclassified.** Every caller of `/api/v1/i18n/translations` at the head: the console loader; `examples/console-starter/src/main.tsx` (returns the payload with no predicate at all); the e2e boot mock `e2e/console-boot-indicator.spec.ts:308`, which answers `{ success: true, data: {} }` (no `data.translations`, so the loader hands the whole envelope to the predicate: `success` is a boolean, `data` is not a group name → `false`, pinned as a control). No MSW or mock translation server exists in the console (`apps/console` has no `msw`/`setupWorker` reference outside `.gitignore`; `apps/console/vite.config.ts:1069` proxies `/api` to a real server; `apps/console/public/` holds only icons). Test loaders feed `{}` and `{ common: { save } }` only (`LocaleSwitcher.appLocales`, `provider-app-locale-restore`, `provider-tenant-locale-seed`). The real server (`objectstack` `packages/runtime/src/domains/i18n.ts:71-90`) answers `{ locale, translations }` with the merged spec tree from `i18nService.getTranslations`, never an i18next namespace tree. Built-in pack namespaces: I listed the top-level keys of all ten packs (`en, zh, ja, ko, de, fr, es, pt, ru, ar`); none is spelled like a group (nearest: `fields`, `dashboard`, `actions`, `report`, `notifications`, `wizard`, `flowRunner`). The run-time check the report describes is real: `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/spec-translations.test.ts` imports `builtInLocales` from `../locales` (source, via the root vitest alias), reads `Object.keys(pack)` for every pack and asserts `isSpecTranslationData({ [ns]: { key: 'value' } })` is `false` for each. The one reclassified shape (an un-namespaced flat tree with top-level `objects`) has no producer in either repo, and it was already unreadable at the root since `getAppNamespaces` looks one level down.
- **(c) Transform on label-only and flows-only payloads — no throw, readable output.** `transformSpecTranslations` (`spec-translations.ts:152-217`) copies `objects.NAME.label` and skips a missing `fields`; a label-only payload yields `{ app: { objects: { crm_lead: { label } } } }`. A flows-only payload skips the `objects` loop entirely (`data.objects` undefined) and forwards `flows` verbatim through the "any other top-level key" loop, yielding `{ app: { flows } }`. Readers: `getAppNamespaces` (`packages/i18n/src/useObjectLabel.ts:129-140`) accepts `app` (not in `BUILTIN_KEYS`, has `objects`) and `objectLabel` resolves `app.objects.crm_lead.label` (lines 178-183, 302-303); `FlowRunner` (`packages/app-shell/src/views/FlowRunner.tsx:190-198`) iterates every namespace of the tree for a `flows[flowName]` entry; the console's `useSettingsLabel` discovers any namespace carrying `settings` and scans all namespaces for `settingsCommon`. Both shapes are pinned in the i18n test and rendered end to end through the real loader in the console test (`线索`; `转化详情` and `商机名称`).
- **(d) The console walk is real and can fail.** `apps/console/src/loadLanguage.test.tsx` imports `GetTranslationsResponseSchema` from `@objectstack/spec/api`; the root `vitest.config.mts` aliases `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/app-shell` to package sources (lines 502, 538) and does not alias `@objectstack/spec`, so the walk reads the installed 17.4.0 and the predicate under test is the head source. `apps/console/vitest.config.ts` is a root project (line 462), so CI's Test shards collect the file. The walk carries a positive control (`arrayContaining(['objects', 'flows'])`), requires `safeParse` success per group, and asserts the loader answers exactly `['app']`. My probe reproduced the report's ablation 2: dropping `datasets` from the list turns exactly the `datasets` leg red (the loader returns `{ datasets: {} }` untransformed). One-directional, as the report says.
- **(e) Changeset sentences all true; pins able to fail.** `.changeset/10235-spec-translation-bundle-recognised-by-any-group.md`: the loader description matches `apps/console/src/loadLanguage.ts:27-36` (unchanged vs the merge-base `1dbb9933c`); the old rule is the merge-base predicate; the eleven groups named match the list and the spec; "walk that group list off `GetTranslationsResponseSchema`" is the console test; "no built-in locale pack namespace is spelled like one" verified above; "a group-named key holding a string or an array is not treated as a group" is `isPlainObject`; the user-visible sentence names readers that exist (`objectLabel`, `appLabel`/navigation, `dashboards`, `pages` resolvers in `useObjectLabel.ts`, `FlowRunner`).
